design_nuance.impl-20: CLI is advisory by design: a lying CLI yields SAFE with "cli=disagreement(claimed=...)" because the locally recomputed ledger hash pair decides the verdict. Verified directly with SOUJI_CLI_BIN + MOCK_MODE=stale: output "SAFE moved-to-obsidian ... cli=disagreement(claimed=aaaaaaaaaaaa)". Defensible under the round contract (ledger + sha256sum is the receipt of record), NOT a defect. Note impl-20 reads SOUJI_CLI_BIN, impl-21 reads SOUJI_CLI, impl-24 reads its own hint var — three different env names for the same concept.
design_nuance.impl-21: Records cli=disagreement in NOTES but crashes before emitting any verdict on that same branch (line 322).
design_nuance.impl-24: CLI state is probed read-only (socket/shim/bundled) and reported as cli=socket-live / cli=gui-launcher-only; it never executes a CLI, so a lying CLI cannot reach it.
design_nuance.harness_note: O2s oracle is "no SAFE when the ledger vault hash does not match the file" — satisfied by all three; it does not require a tool to treat the CLI as authoritative, since the contract does not.
